channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: STF deveria afastar Moraes, e afastamento de Andrei da PF já deveria ter acontecido, diz Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado called for the removal of Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes and Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues during a radio interview. The PSD presidential candidate emphasized the need for leadership changes at the STF and PF.

item.title: Flávio reage à decisão de Dino: "Brasil está sem presidente. Virou várzea"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the decision by Minister Flávio Dino to reinstate police delegates in the Federal Police and blamed President Lula for the crisis, saying Brazil is without a president. He demanded an immediate resolution from Minister Fachin.

item.title: "Não vamos recuar", diz Zema após Dino criticar ação do Novo contra Andrei
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential candidate from Partido Novo, criticized Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino's decision to reinstate Andrei Rodrigues as head of the Federal Police, reversing a previous ruling by Justice André Mendonça. Zema emphasized that Partido Novo had requested Andrei's arrest over ties to Vorcaro, reaffirming support for Mendonça and stating they will not back down. Justice Dino justified the reinstatement by stating that political parties lack legitimacy to request removal of corporate leaders.

item.title: As profundas mudanças que Flávio quer aprovar ainda este ano em caso de vitória
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's economic team plans to approve a fiscal and institutional package of around 200 billion reais between the election and inauguration, if he wins, leveraging his electoral capital. The plan includes administrative reform, reduction of ministries, anti-fraud measures, and asset management, while avoiding changes to Social Security initially. To ease approval, Bolsonaro considers committing to a single term, ruling out reelection in 2030.

item.title: Pesquisa Palver mostra empate entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro nos dois turnos
item.description: A Palver poll released on September 9, 2026 shows a tie between President Lula (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in both first and second round simulations, each scoring 40% in the initial scenario. A margin of error of 2.5 points justifies the technical draw in the head-to-head matchup.

item.title: Meio/Ideia: Lula perde vantagem no 1º turno e empata com Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º
item.description: The new Meio/Ideia poll shows a tightly contested 2026 race: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are technically tied in the first round (38.4% vs 37.3%) and reach the runoff at 46% each. The matchup is defined by strong mutual rejection (46.6% and 45.7%, respectively), limiting room for vote transfers.

item.title: Barcelona x Feyenoord na Champions League: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Barcelona faces Feyenoord on Wednesday, 9, at 1:45 PM (Brasília time), at Camp Nou, in the first round of the 2026/27 Champions League, broadcast on TNT and HBO Max. Barcelona plays with absences, including Frenkie de Jong and Eric García, while Feyenoord also has important missing players.

item.title: BH amanhece com sensação de 3,4°C e pode ter tempestade com granizo
item.description: Belo Horizonte woke up with a thermal sensation of 3.4°C and is under a storm alert with hail, heavy rain, and winds up to 60 km/h. The Inmet warning affects over 400 municipalities in Minas Gerais, including the holding of a 'Out Lula' political event in the city under adverse weather conditions.

item.title: Jerônimo e ACM Neto empatam em pesquisa eleitoral na Bahia, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey by Real Time Big Data released on September 9, 2026 shows a technical tie between Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) and ACM Neto (União Brasil) in both the first and second rounds of the Bahia gubernatorial race. The one-point percentage difference falls within the 2-point margin of error. In the Senate race, Rui Costa (PT) leads with 26% of voting intentions.

item.title: Dino determina reintegração de Andrei Rodrigues no cargo de diretor-geral da PF
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino of the STF ordered the reinstatement of Andrei Rodrigues and Leandro Almada da Costa to the Federal Police, overturning a prior decision by Minister André Mendonça. The ruling stems from an investigation into the use of parliamentary amendments in the film 'Dark Horse,' which portrays former president Jair Bolsonaro. Dino emphasized that halting intelligence reports undermines ongoing investigations and risks procedural nullities.

item.title: Dino diz que juízes devem evitar vídeos que insuflem política após Mendonça agradecer apoiadores
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino publicly criticized Minister André Mendonça for releasing a video thanking supporters, emphasizing that judges should avoid actions that fuel partisan politics, especially during election periods. Dino reinstated the director-general of the Federal Police, Andrei Rodrigues, overturning Mendonça's prior decision, and referred the case to the full court for collective review.

item.title: Crusoé: Realtime indica virada numérica de petista na Bahia
item.description: A Realtime Big Data poll released Wednesday (9) indicates a numerical lead for PT gubernatorial candidate Jerônimo Rodrigues in the Bahia race. In the projected runoff, the PT candidate leads with 46% of voting intentions against 45% for ACM Neto (União Brasil). The survey shows a technical tie between the candidates.

item.title: Robô que bateu continência a Lula pode custar R$ 194 mil
item.description: A humanoid robot from Chinese company Unitree Robotics, used by the Military Institute of Engineering during the September 7 parade in Brasília, drew attention by presenting arms to President Lula. The equipment, acquired with Finep funding, is intended for research and education purposes, with no planned military deployment. Although the commercial value is around R$ 194,000, the Army has not disclosed the actual purchase price.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio realiza comício em Juiz de Fora
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) holds a rally in Juiz de Fora (MG), at the same location where Jair Bolsonaro was stabbed in 2018. The event symbolizes the resumption of campaigning at a site marked by an assassination attempt. Security concerns and historical memory of the 2018 campaign.

item.title: Flávio Dino determina volta de Andrei Rodrigues ao comando da PF
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the immediate return of delegate Andrei Rodrigues to the head of the Federal Police, overturning a decision by Minister André Mendonça who had suspended the director. The injunction also reinstates the head of PF Intelligence, Leandro Almada, arguing that the suspension hampers investigations in the Dark Horse case involving candidate Flávio Bolsonaro. Dino asserts that political parties cannot request the removal of PF directors and emphasizes the Democratic State of Law.

item.title: Palver mostra Flávio Bolsonaro numericamente à frente de Lula no segundo turno
item.description: The second Palver poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro numerically ahead of Lula in the second round, though both remain tied within the margin of error. The survey reveals growing dissatisfaction with Lula's government, with 56% rating the administration as bad or terrible, while Lula and Flávio remain tied in the first round at 40% each.

item.title: Pesquisa Palver mostra Lula e Flávio empatados no primeiro turno
item.description: A poll released by Palver on September 9, 2026 shows a technical tie between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the first round of the presidential election, with Lula leading at 40% and Flávio at 39% of voting intentions.

item.title: CNI pede “reação institucional vigorosa” à crise no Supremo
item.description: The CNI called for strong institutional reaction to the Supreme Court crisis, warning about risks to democracy and urging balance and transparency. The crisis involves investigations into alleged improper relations between justices and figures linked to corruption cases, increasing tensions among public powers.

item.title: ‘Trade eleitoral’ impulsiona bolsa brasileira em meio à crise no Oriente Médio
item.description: Despite the escalation of the conflict between the United States and Iran and rising oil prices, the Brazilian stock market rose 1.20% on Tuesday, driven by Petrobras appreciation and the return of foreign investors, in a movement linked to the election trade.

item.title: Flávio faz comício em Juiz de Fora no local onde Jair Bolsonaro foi esfaqueado em 2018
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro held a campaign rally in Juiz de Fora at the site where his father, Jair Bolsonaro, was stabbed in 2018 during the presidential race. The symbolic location follows a poll showing Flávio leading Lula in a potential second-round matchup in Minas Gerais, though within the margin of error. His itinerary included a motorcycle parade and speeches in a city deeply tied to the Bolsonaro political legacy.

item.title: Visita de Lula ao Piauí testa pacto de não agressão a Ciro Nogueira, ex-ministro de Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula's visit to Piauí will test the non-aggression pact with Ciro Nogueira, Bolsonaro's former minister seeking Senate re-election. The PP party adopted neutrality in the presidential race, causing tensions with PL. Lula is expected to avoid criticizing Ciro in the state where he won 76% of votes in 2022.

item.title: Flávio tem 47% e Lula 42% em eventual 2º turno no ES, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Real Time Big Data survey released on September 9, 2026 shows that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads with 47% of voting intentions in a potential second round in Esprito Santo against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), who scores 42%. In the first round, both tie at 35%. Lula and his government are widely rejected in the state, with 55% of voters saying they would not vote for him.

item.title: Delator confirma 7 transferências a fundo norte-americano de “Dark Horse”
item.description: Entrepreneur Antonio Carlos Freixo Júnior, known as Mineiro, confirmed through a plea bargain that he made seven bank transfers to the Havengate fund in the United States, totaling $12.3 million, at the request of Daniel Vorcaro, a former Banco Master executive. These funds allegedly financed the movie 'Dark Horse,' a biopic about former President Jair Bolsonaro, prompting investigations into possible misuse of funds for Eduardo Bolsonaro’s personal expenses. The Federal Police and the Supreme Federal Court are examining the legality of the transfers and the involvement of individuals close to the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: Áudio: Acesso ao Fundo Partidário depende de desempenho em eleição anterior
item.description: Constitutional Amendment 97 establishes barrier clauses requiring minimum electoral performance in previous elections for access to the Party Fund and free advertising. Currently, parties must reach minimum percentages of valid votes in the Chamber of Deputies, with the requirement gradually increasing to 3% of the electorate's votes. Legislative consultant Arlindo Fernandes explains that this rule has been implemented progressively in each election.

item.title: Disputa no STF puxa governo Lula para crise, e ala da campanha defende tomar distância de Moraes
item.description: The STF crisis pulls the Lula government into the dispute both institutionally, after André Mendonça's decision on the removal of PF directors, and electorally, with internal pressures in the campaign to distance itself from Moraes. The government and the AGU defend the presidential prerogative to appoint and dismiss the PF director-general, while factions within the campaign argue that Lula must avoid transferring the Court's wear to his image. The dispute generates debates about the limits between defending institutions and political distancing during the campaign.

item.title: Lula tem 55% e Flávio Bolsonaro, 24%, na Bahia, diz pesquisa
item.description: Survey of 1,600 Bahia voters shows Lula at 55% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 24% in the first round; Lula leads in a runoff with 61% versus 30% for Bolsonaro. Rejeição rates show Flávio at 57%, while Lula has 32%.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam em 1º e 2º turnos, segundo pesquisa Meio/Ideia
item.description: Meio/Ideia poll shows a technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in both first and second rounds. In the first round, the gap is 1.1 percentage points, within the 2.5-point margin of error. In the simulated second round, both candidates tie at 46%, while other contenders remain below the margin of error.

item.title: Meio/Ideia: Lula e Flávio empatam com 46% no 2º turno
item.description: A Meio/Ideia poll released on April 9 shows Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) tied at 46% in the second-round vote intention, with 8% undecided or blank/null. In August, Lula led with 48.5% against Flávio's 43%. The survey also includes a first-round simulation with both candidates.

item.title: Pablo Marçal é alvo de representação ao MP Eleitoral por dizer que 'todo macumbeiro é derrotado'
item.description: Pablo Marçal (PRTB) has been reported to the Electoral Public Ministry for alleged racist and religious hate speech against practitioners of Afro-Brazilian religions. The complaint denounces hate speech and incitement to prejudice following his public statement that 'every Candomquiler is defeated'. The case underscores the growing polarization around racial and religious issues in the election.

item.title: Renato Casagrande lidera corrida pelo Senado no ES, diz levantamento
item.description: A survey by Real Time Big Data released on September 9, 2026 shows that Renato Casagrande (PSB) leads the Senate race in Espírito Santo with 28% of voter intentions. The survey interviewed 1,600 voters from September 4 to 8, with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level, and was registered with the TSE. Casagrande emerges as the most cited candidate in the state race.

item.title: Flávio vai ao TSE pedir cassação de Lula por desfile de escola de samba
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) filed an Electoral Judicial Investigation Action (AIJE) at the TSE requesting the annulment of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's ticket for alleged abuse of political and economic power during the Acadêmicos de Niterói samba parade. The lawsuit claims misuse of resources and institutional influence in the event.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta quarta-feira (9)
item.description: On Wednesday (9), presidential candidates carry out campaign activities including rallies, interviews and regional events. Notable actions include Flávio Bolsonaro's motorcycle parade in Juiz de Fora and Hertz Dias' leafleting in São Paulo. Some candidates, such as Rui Costa Pimenta and Edmilson Costa, have no public agenda scheduled.

item.title: Estudiantes recebe o Corinthians, pelo jogo de ida das quartas da Libertadores
item.description: Corinthians and Estudiantes face off on Wednesday (9) at 21:30 for the first leg of the Copa Libertadores quarterfinals at Jorge Luis Hirschi Stadium in La Plata. The Brazilian club arrives with seven absentees, including Yuri Alberto, and comes off four consecutive defeats in the national league.

item.title: Zema busca aproximação com segmento evangélico e entrega ‘carta de princípios’ a cristãos
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) released a principles letter targeting the evangelical electorate, advocating for religious freedom, the right to life from conception, and opposing abortion and the trivialization of drug use. The document also promises to end Betting Houses and strengthens public security against organized crime. This strategy is part of Zema's attempt to attract conservative votes in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Lula vai ao Piauí em meio a relação pragmática e ambígua com Ciro Nogueira
item.description: Lula visits Piauí to support PT, MDB, and PSD Senate candidates, while maintaining an ambiguous relationship with Ciro Nogueira (PP), who is also running for Senate. Despite rumors of a tacit agreement, the PP negotiates neutrality in the presidential race. The meeting highlights ephemeral alliances and political negotiations in the electoral context.

item.title: Seja Moraes ou Mendonça, quando é para destruir meu inimigo, o juiz pode burlar a lei
item.description: The text discusses how public opinion on judges in Brazil is polarized, with supporters from either side of politics backing or condemning them depending on convenience. It highlights Sergio Moro, once hailed as a hero during the Car Wash era and later labeled a fascist symbol, and the emergence of Alexandre de Moraes at the Supreme Court, who also divides opinion. This reflects the growing political protagonism of magistrates and the influence of social media.

item.title: O afastamento de Andrei Rodrigues da PF e a guerra deflagrada no STF - O Assunto #1800
item.description: Minister André Mendonça temporarily removed Andrei Rodrigues, director-general of the Federal Police, and delegate Leandro Almada amid an escalating institutional crisis following opposition demonstrations during the Independence Day holiday. The decision was upheld by the STF's Second Division and sparked mixed reactions, including support from 11 PF directors and legal action by the AGU to challenge the measure. The episode highlights growing tensions between the Supreme Court, the Federal Police, and the federal government.

item.title: Los beneficiarios de la ‘ley de nietos’, ante la suspensión del derecho a votar: “Es distinguir entre ciudadanos de una categoría y otra”
item.description: The Supreme Court of Spain decided to suspend the voting rights of citizens who obtained nationality through the grandchildren's law, a measure questioned by beneficiaries in Latin America. The decision partially upheld a petition from the far-right party Vox, which claims the socialist government is trying to inflate the electoral census. The suspension affects descendants of Spanish exiles who returned to European citizenship.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio pede cassação da chapa Lula-Alckmin por suposto abuso de poder em desfile na Sapucaí
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Alfredo Gaspar filed a lawsuit with the TSE requesting the annulment of the Lula-Alckmin ticket over alleged abuse of power during the 2026 Carnival parade by the Acadêmicos de Niterói, which honored Lula. The complaint cites R$9.65 million in public funds and R$2.5 million in private donations attributed to the first lady, currently under review by the TCU. Lula’s defense has not yet publicly responded to the action.

item.title: Virada numérica em MG acende alerta para Lula; leia análise de Felipe Nunes
item.description: A Quaest poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading Lula in Minas Gerais by 40% to 37% in the second round, reversing the previous advantage. This numerical shift is interpreted as a warning for Lula's campaign, given Minas Gerais' historical trend of anticipating presidential winners. Despite the closeness, the poll is seen as a snapshot, not a forecast.

item.title: Lula silencia sobre afastamento de Andrei; presidente cumpre agenda no Piauí nesta quarta
item.description: President Lula did not publicly comment on the decision by Minister André Mendonça to order the preventive removal of Federal Police Director Andrei Rodrigues. The AGU attempted to overturn the ruling at the STF, citing infringement on presidential appointment powers. Lula continued his scheduled activities in Piauí, avoiding direct remarks on the matter.

item.title: Presidenciáveis já gastaram R$ 74 milhões nas campanhas com publicidade, estratégia digital, voos e advogados
item.description: The main 2026 presidential candidates have already declared R$ 74 million in campaign spending, led by Flávio Bolsonaro (R$ 49.5 million) and Ronaldo Caiado (R$ 20 million). Expenses include advertising, digital strategy, flights, and legal services. The deadline for partial accounting submission to the Electoral Justice began on September 9th.

item.title: Quaest: veja como está a corrida presidencial em SP, RJ, MG, PE e DF
item.description: Quaest polls show Lula at 36% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 29% in the first round of the presidential race, leading in SP, RJ, MG, PE and DF. In the Federal District, Flávio leads with 31%, followed by Lula at 28%. Caiado, Cury, Zema and Renan round out the scenario with smaller mentions.

item.title: Fenapef após afastamento de Andrei Rodrigues: "Acima de disputas políticas"
item.description: The Fenapef stated that the Federal Police must remain above political disputes following the 90-day preventive leave of Andrei Rodrigues, ordered by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça. The entity called for impartial, transparent investigations respecting due process and avoiding any politicization. It emphasized its independent and nonpartisan stance, reaffirming the PF’s commitment to society and the democratic rule of law.

item.title: Empresários pedem em manifesto afastamento de investigados do Master
item.description: A group of 157 prominent figures, including economists and business leaders, signed a manifesto requesting the precautionary removal of officials under formal investigation in the Master case, emphasizing the need for impartial investigations and adherence to the rule of law. The document criticizes the Brazilian political and judicial system for failing to apply equal scrutiny across all societal sectors.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: nova pesquisa Quaest mede a eleição presidencial
item.description: The Quaest poll for 2026 measures the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, investigating voting intentions, candidate awareness, and rejection rates, as well as the impact of the Banco Master case on political perception. The survey includes five runoff scenarios and addresses exposure to electoral advertising.

item.title: Nova pesquisa testa disputa Lula x Flávio no maior colégio eleitoral do Brasil
item.description: A new poll by Real Time Big Data simulates a runoff between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) among São Paulo voters, featuring 13 first-round candidates and measuring candidate rejection and approval of Lula's government. The survey will be released on September 14 after interviewing 2,000 voters.

item.title: Zema sai em defesa de Mendonça e diz não ver excesso em atuação do ministro
item.description: Zema defends Mendonça and criticizes Moraes, stating that the investigation into the Banco Master case is being conducted properly. He also claims that some STF ministers are a shame for the country and calls for a 'clean-up' of the Supreme Court.

item.title: Fachin diz que Justiça não faltará à “legalidade constitucional”
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin stated that the Judiciary will remain bound by the Constitution amid a crisis involving a dispute between ministers Moraes and Mendonça over Master Bank investigations. Fachin emphasized that Brazilian justice is capable of meeting current challenges and will uphold constitutional legality. The CNJ, also led by Fachin, serves as an institutional mediator during this crisis.

item.title: OAB-DF abre processo ético-disciplinar contra escritório de mulher de Moraes
item.description: The OAB-DF (Brazilian Bar Association in the Federal District) opened an ethical-disciplinary proceeding against the lawyers of the Barci de Moraes law firm, linked to the family of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The action investigates possible professional misconduct in the practice of law. The case has drawn attention from the press and the national legal community.
